# Template: screening-design review checklist

Use this checklist before presenting a cooling calculation, model result, or test result as support for a decision.

## Problem and boundary

- [ ] The protected location, temperature requirement, and time basis are explicit.
- [ ] Heat-load magnitude, distribution, duty cycle, and evidence status are explicit.
- [ ] The sink condition and environmental/loop boundary are explicit.
- [ ] The drawing shows what is inside and outside the model or test boundary.

## Physics and units

- [ ] Governing relation, sign convention, and units are shown.
- [ ] Fluid/material properties include composition, temperature, and pressure state where relevant.
- [ ] A limiting-case or conservation check is recorded.
- [ ] Local peak temperature is not inferred from an average fluid or enclosure temperature without a valid path model.

## Evidence and applicability

- [ ] Every material input is marked measured, reported, simulated, derived, assumed, or unknown.
- [ ] Geometry, configuration, source version, and operating condition match the intended claim.
- [ ] Model/test uncertainty, repeatability, convergence, or sensitivity is recorded at a level appropriate to the decision.
- [ ] The conclusion does not extend beyond the documented envelope.

## Decision and next step

- [ ] The conclusion uses bounded language appropriate to the evidence level.
- [ ] The dominant uncertainty and credible failure mode are named.
- [ ] The next measurement, model, or review capable of changing the decision is defined.
- [ ] Any high-consequence design, procurement, safety, or compliance decision is routed to the applicable qualified review process.

See the [validation ladder](../validation-ladder.md) for the evidence level that supports each claim.
